subject: Joint success playbook: aligning scope, owners & 60-day timeline
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@novasystems.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@novasystems.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint success playbook: aligning scope, owners & 60-day timeline

Hi Alicia and Liam —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Alicia, great to meet you; per our conversation you sound like the right champion internally to drive this. I wanted to share a concise "joint success playbook" draft (attached) so we can agree on goals, owners, and a 60-day timeline to get to a meaningful pilot. High level ask: can you confirm the primary outcome you care about and the internal stakeholders who should be owners for each area?

Proposed goals (editable in the attached):
- Validate model quality vs. your internal intent set (acceptance criteria in sheet 2)
- Pilot in a sandbox with 100k tokens/day throughput to measure latency/cost
- Evaluate data handling and security controls required for Private deployment or Dedicated capacity

Suggested 60-day cadence (flexible):
1) Week 0–2: Evaluation — share sample prompts, run baseline generation on a small dataset, and collect quality metrics
2) Week 3–6: Pilot — deploy to a scoped app path, measure performance/cost, and iterate on prompts/configs
3) Week 7–8: Production prep — finalize routing, rollout plan, and compliance checklist

Proposed owners (please add or correct):
- Champion: Alicia Torres (Novasystems)
- Technical lead: Liam Chen (Novasystems)
- AE / Program lead: Mateo Alvarez (Redwood Inference)
- Customer Success: Monica Patel (Redwood Inference)

Attached: JointSuccess_Playbook_v1.xlsx (playbook template), evaluation_prompts.pdf (sample prompt set).

Next steps: If this looks reasonable, can you confirm the outcome you want us to prioritize and who else (legal, security, ops) should be looped in? Also propose two 30–45 minute slots for a kickoff call this week or early next week.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: JointSuccess_Playbook_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), evaluation_prompts.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@novasystems.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@novasystems.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint success playbook: aligning scope, owners & 60-day timeline

Thanks Mateo — and thanks everyone for coordinating.

Confirming: I will be the internal champion and will own executive alignment. Liam will be our technical lead. Please also add Priya Desai (priya.desai@novasystems.com) to the thread — she runs ML Ops and will be relevant for data access and sandboxing.

Outcome we care most about: reduce time-to-insight for support ticket summarization and intent routing with a measurable lift in routing accuracy (target +12% precision over baseline). If we can show a clear delta in the pilot and confirm throughput targets, we'll greenlight a 6–12 month capacity commitment.

Two quick questions up front:
1) Data controls — can you share a one-page summary of your Private deployment options and SOC 2 controls?
2) Eval metrics — what format do you prefer for quality metrics (CSV export, dashboard link, or both)?

For kickoff slots — Thurs 1–1:45pm PT or Fri 10–10:45am PT work for me.

On the attachments: I looked quickly at the playbook and the prompts — the acceptance criteria look reasonable, but I'll ask Priya to run through the data access column and confirm.

Best,
Alicia
VP of Product Operations | Novasystems
alicia.torres@novasystems.com

Hi Alicia — great, thanks for confirming. Looping Priya in would be helpful; Alicia, feel free to add her to the thread or I can do an intro.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Private & compliance summary: attaching a 1-page controls cheat-sheet to the drive link (see related links). We support SOC 2 Type II, KMS integrations, and VPC/private control plane options for more regulated workloads. We'll surface a short matrix of what's required for on-prem versus VPC vs hosted.
- Eval metrics: CSV + dashboard is best. We'll export per-prompt precision/recall and token-level latency (CSV) and share a short dashboard for the pilot so stakeholders can self-serve.

Below is an updated, compressed 8-week plan with responsibilities. Please confirm and we'll lock dates.

Compressed 8-week plan (dates are examples):
- Weeks 0–2 (Evaluation): Nov 5–Jun 12 — sample data ingestion (sandbox), run batch eval, initial quality review
- Weeks 3–6 (Pilot): Jun 13–Jul 10 — scoped integration, latency & cost profiling, prompt tuning cycles
- Weeks 7–8 (Prod prep): Jul 11–Jul 24 — compliance sign-offs, rollout playbook, SLA discussion

Owners (confirmed so far):
- Champion/Exec: Alicia Torres (Novasystems) — executive alignment & prioritization
- Tech lead: Liam Chen (Novasystems) — data access & integration
- AE / Program lead: Mateo Alvarez (Redwood Inference) — program coordination, blockers
- CSM: Monica Patel (Redwood Inference) — onboarding, success criteria tracking

If that structure looks good, can we pick Thurs 1–1:45pm PT for the kickoff? I'll book and send a short agenda (30–45 minutes): 1) goals & acceptance criteria (10m), 2) roles & timeline review (10m), 3) data access & next steps (10–25m).

Thanks — I will also drop the playbook into a shared Drive folder and create the HubSpot deal record if it helps with handoffs.

—
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: evaluation_prompts.pdf (application/pdf)

- I'll create a shared action tracker and invite Alicia, Liam, Priya, Mateo, and a small ops contact from our side. Link will be posted after you confirm the kickoff slot.
